`mixed-scripts.pdf` is a synthetic one-page conversion test, not a personal book.
It contains Chinese, Japanese, kana, Korean and Thai (including combining marks) with
subset-embedded Noto Sans CJK JP 2.004 and Noto Sans Thai fonts.

Sources: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/tree/Sans2.004 and
https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/tree/main/hinted/ttf/NotoSansThai.
The font licences are included alongside the fixture.
